description: This file contains utility classes and methods for working with the FreeMarker template engine within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides configuration setup, template rendering, cache management, and custom loader implementations to facilitate template processing and rendering in the context of OFBiz components.

classes.name: FreeMarkerWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing configuration, template rendering, caching, custom loader implementations, and exception handling for FreeMarker templates within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getDefaultOfbizWrapper
methods.description: Returns the default BeansWrapper configured for OFBiz, used for FreeMarker object wrapping.

methods.name: newConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new FreeMarker Configuration instance with OFBiz-specific settings.

methods.name: makeConfiguration
methods.description: Initializes and returns a FreeMarker Configuration object with custom settings, shared variables, template loaders, and transform classes.

methods.name: transformsURL
methods.description: Provides URLs of resources matching the freemarkerTransforms.properties location across components.

methods.name: loadTransforms
methods.description: Loads and registers FreeMarker transform classes from properties into the configuration.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a compiled FreeMarker Template to a provided Appendable based on a given context.

methods.name: renderTemplateFromString
methods.description: Creates a template from a string and renders it with optional caching and modification time awareness.

methods.name: clearTemplateFromCache
methods.description: Removes a specific template from the cache.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a FreeMarker Template instance with a specific context and output writer.

methods.name: applyUserSettings
methods.description: Applies locale and timezone settings from context to the FreeMarker Environment.

methods.name: getDefaultOfbizConfig
methods.description: Returns the singleton OFBiz-specific FreeMarker Configuration instance.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a Template from cache or loads it from the configuration.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a Template with caching support from cache and configuration.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from args map or from the template context in the environment.

methods.name: getWrappedObject
methods.description: Extracts the underlying object from a FreeMarker BeanModel or Scalar.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts a FreeMarker TemplateModel object to its Java counterpart.

methods.name: createEnvironmentMap
methods.description: Creates a map of variable names and their wrapped objects from a FreeMarker Environment.

methods.name: saveContextValues
methods.description: Copies specific context entries into a separate map for later restoration.

methods.name: saveValues
methods.description: Creates a copy of specified context entries.

methods.name: reloadValues
methods.description: Restores saved context values into the current environment and env variables.

methods.name: removeValues
methods.description: Removes specific keys from the context map.

methods.name: overrideWithArgs
methods.description: Overrides context entries with provided arguments, handling null and scalar conversions.

methods.name: getSiteParameters
methods.description: Extracts web site parameters (rootDir, webSiteId, https) from ServletRequest and sets them into context.

methods.name: autoWrap
methods.description: Wraps an object into a FreeMarker TemplateModel using the default OFBiz wrapper.

methods.name: FlexibleTemplateLoader
methods.description: Custom TemplateLoader to resolve component:// templates from OFBiz component locations.

methods.name: handleTemplateException
methods.description: Handles template exceptions quietly, logging and outputting a placeholder message.

methods.name: handleTemplateExceptionVerbosily
methods.description: Handles template exceptions verbosely, logging and outputting the exception message.

classes.name: FlexibleTemplateLoader
classes.description: Custom URLTemplateLoader for locating templates based on component paths or database storage.
